items.title: Gravita Q2 FY27: revenue up 38% to Rs 1,427 cr, PAT up 6% to Rs 102 cr; lead volumes fall
items.text: Gravita reported Q2 FY27 (filed 27 Oct) revenue of Rs 1,427 crore (+38% YoY), EBITDA of Rs 143.37 crore (10.04% margin vs 10.80%) and PAT of Rs 102.01 crore (+6%, margin 7.15% vs 9.27%). Lead volumes fell to 39,203 MT from 44,187 MT, while the new copper vertical added 4,236 MT. The coverage does not discuss Li-ion recycling beyond listing lithium as a vertical, so the battery-metal leg remains immaterial to earnings and the stock still trades on lead, aluminium and copper.
